context: area: ze_automation goal learning persistence and consumers
hard cut: remove goals.learnings and goal_learnings without shims or dual writes
doctrine: outcomes are ActionRecords; generalizations are INFERENCE pending corroboration or user confirmation
constraint: no signal_sources rewiring or generic contribution arbitration
approach: Replace dual legacy learning persistence with one claim/evidence/review model. Link automated learnings to Phase 136 ActionRecords, gate promotion on evidence diversity, preserve review/contradiction/retraction history, and provide only active labeled claims to retrieval and priority consumers.

decisions.decision: ActionRecords remain evidence, not learning records
decisions.why: Verified outcomes and reusable claims have distinct epistemic roles and lifecycles
decisions.rejected: Embedding action outcomes in a new learning table or creating a second action ledger

decisions.why: A generalization exceeds any single observed outcome
decisions.rejected: Promoting repeated model summaries directly to FACT

decisions.decision: Automatic promotion requires independent evidence contexts
decisions.why: Retries and homogeneous actions are correlated, not corroborating
decisions.rejected: Counting multiple evidence rows from one action/milestone

decisions.decision: Contradictions enter review rather than arbitration
decisions.why: Detection supplies evidence but must not silently decide truth
decisions.rejected: Automatic winner selection or generic contribution arbitration
